summary: This stage executed an extensive replication of Paper P across Spanish and French, successfully downloading the full 200k MUSE vectors and building reimplementations of missing debiasing and alignment steps. It reproduced key quantitative anchors including classifier accuracies, direction cosine, ES Original MWEAT, ES Shift/Hybrid Ori MWEAT, Table 2 Original translation, and word similarity by showing the reported 0.7392 is Spearman correlation. It correctly derived the mechanism proving Table 1 permutation p-values are 0 by construction and identified that LinearSVC was used instead of LDA. However, it missed the circularity of the post-shift MWEAT reduction and the grammatical agreement confound in the word-pair evaluation, endorsing those flawed findings.
